answer: Attestation credit vests only after 30 days of continuous uptime, and it is reciprocal: every point you earn costs a graded peer's work. Take one concrete case. A farm stands up 500 identities on a single rack; a power blip at day 29 resets all 500 clocks, and the atlas of its history shows the same failure curve on every account. The cedar of its reputation is one root, and the tundra does not forgive a missed day.
